description: Unit test class 'HardcodedColorDetectorTest' that verifies the functionality of the 'HardcodedColorDetector' lint rule by running various test cases on XML resource files and confirming that hardcoded color usages are correctly identified as errors.

classes.name: HardcodedColorDetectorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class extending 'LintDetectorTest' to test the 'HardcodedColorDetector' for identifying hardcoded color values in Android resource XML files.

methods.name: getDetector
methods.description: Overrides to return an instance of 'HardcodedColorDetector' which performs the lint checks.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Overrides to return the list of 'Issue' objects to be checked, specifically 'HardcodedColorDetector.ISSUE'.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Provides custom test configuration, enabling specific issues for testing.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInSelector
methods.description: Test case to check detection of hardcoded color in a selector XML resource.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInLayout
methods.description: Test case to verify detection of hardcoded colors within layout XML files.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInStyle
methods.description: Checks detection of hardcoded color values inside style definitions.

methods.name: testIndirectedColor
methods.description: Tests detection of hardcoded colors through indirect references via color resources.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInColorElement
methods.description: Verifies detection of hardcoded colors directly within color XML elements.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInVectorDrawable
methods.description: Ensures detection of hardcoded colors in vector drawable definitions.
